what: Hegseth says clock paused on deadline to seek approval for Iran war

clean_source_blocks.text: US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth has argued that the clock has paused on a deadline for the Trump administration to seek approval from Congress for the US-Israeli war with Iran.
The US defence secretary says the timer for the president to report to Congress "pauses or stops" in a ceasefire.

“On Iran, ultimately, I would defer to the White House and White House counsel on that. However, we are in a ceasefire right now, which our understanding means the 60-day clock pauses or stops,” Hegseth responded.
Answering questions from senators on Thursday, Hegseth said: "We are in a ceasefire right now, which our understanding means the 60-day clock pauses or stops in a ceasefire."
